lines.text: How's the elbow been since last time, Fiona?
Since last time the outside of my elbow only twinges when I lift the kettle.
Grand. Keep squeezing the putty and turning the wrist down slowly with the tin of beans, every evening.
Thanks Fiona, I'll see you in three weeks. Is that Sunil? Come on in.
Hi, yeah. I've done something to my ankle playing five-a-side last night.
Ouch. Okay, hop up on the bed and let's see.
